incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P12345 triggered — prometheus_scrape_failures high across metrics-collector cluster in prod. Alert rate spiked at 1855009998.
incident-bot: Affected jobs: prometheus/scrape-configs (k8s), metrics-collector-v2. Links: https://pd.example/p/PD-P12345 | https://grafana.example/d/metrics-overview
maria (oncall): acked — I'm on it. grabbing logs + checking scrape statuses.
maria (oncall): quick check: kubeget pods -n monitoring | grep prometheus
```
prometheus-collector-0   1/1 Running  2d   10.1.4.23
prometheus-collector-1   0/1 CrashLoopBackOff  5m  10.1.4.24
scrape-exporter-3        1/1 Running  12h  10.1.5.11
```
devin: I see collector-1 restarted repeatedly, likely OOM or bad config. Any recent deploys?
maria (oncall): no deploys in last 6h per deploy-bot. pulling prometheus logs from collector-1:
```
2026-03-14T02:34:10Z level=error component=scraper msg="failed to scrape" err="context deadline exceeded"
2026-03-14T02:34:11Z level=warn component=targetmanager msg="target unreachable" target="k8s/pod/metrics-exporter"
2026-03-14T02:34:12Z level=error component=storage msg="write failed" err="timeout writing samples"
```
aj: pinging kube node 10.1.4.24 — node kubelet CPU spiking to 90%, disk i/o high. Could be node-level contention causing scrapes to time out.
katie: also seeing log-ingest-consumer group lag growing in kafka: consumer_group metrics-ingest lag ~1.2M messages, throughput dropped 40% around same time as scrapes.
maria (oncall): initial impact: dashboards show missing metrics for ~10m window, alerts are noisy. Customer-facing services fine — no request errors reported, but monitoring SLO visibility degraded.
devin: mitigation ideas: 1) restart prometheus-collector-1 to clear crashloop 2) cordon + drain node if filesystem/io is bad 3) scale metrics-collector replicas to handle backlog 4) temporarily increase scrape timeout to avoid immediate failures.
aj: I can restart the collector pod, want me to proceed?
maria (oncall): go ahead. I'll watch logs and coordinate kafka side.
aj: doing `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/prometheus-collector -n monitoring` now.
incident-bot: PagerDuty P12345 acknowledged by maria (oncall).
aj: restarted pod, new pod pending on node 10.1.6. Logs show backpressure cleared, prometheus-collector-1 status: Running.
maria (oncall): good. I'm bumping kafka consumer parallelism by scaling deployment metrics-ingest-consumer to 6 -> 12 replicas to process backlog.
katie: scaling consumer to 12. command: `kubectl scale deploy metrics-ingest-consumer --replicas=12 -n ingest`
```
Scaling deployment "metrics-ingest-consumer" from 6 to 12
```
devin: monitoring lag metric now: 1.2M -> 350k and still coming down. scrape success rate improving from 60% -> 92% over last 3m.
maria (oncall): temporary config change: increased scrape timeout from 10s -> 20s for targets matching metrics-exporter to reduce partial failures. Will revert after stable. Patch pushed: https://git.example/infra/monitoring/commit/abc123
aj: node 10.1.4.24 still shows high iowait. Suggest cordon + migrate other pods.
maria (oncall): cordoning 10.1.4.24, draining non-critical pods.
aj: cordoned, starting drain.
incident-bot: PagerDuty P12345 escalated to SRE lead due to >30m active and customer impact potential.
maria (oncall): noted. I'm scheduling 1:1 handoff to aj — I need to step away for an on-call rotation change in 20m. Will drop a summary in the channel and hand off ownership.
maria (oncall): SUMMARY: root cause likely node-level IO contention causing prometheus collector crashes and scrape timeouts; cascaded to kafka consumer lag and delayed log ingestion. Mitigation steps taken: restarted collector, scaled consumers, increased scrape timeout, cordoned problematic node. Current status: scrapes stable (~95%), kafka lag decreasing (~120k), no active customer-facing errors.
aj: taking over oncall. I'll keep an eye for 1h, will initiate node remediation (fs check) and follow up with infra.
katie: adding incident tag in ops tracker and bumping priority for node maintenance.
devin: can someone open incident ticket for postmortem? I'll attach logs and metrics snapshots.
maria (oncall): opened: https://tickets.example/INC-2026-789, adding runbook refs: https://runbooks.example/metrics-ingest.md
pagerduty-bot: P12345 resolved (ack cleared) at 1855011299 — alerts returning to normal thresholds.
maria (oncall): thanks team. I'll add timeline and assign action items to infra for a follow-up.
aj: noted, marking handoff complete. :thumbsup: 
(incident-thread ends — will follow up in postmortem doc)
